title: introduce-prioritized-failure-bucketing-and-lightweight-ensemble-smoke-gate
author: Evelyn Chen
description: Motivation: reduce noisy signal in CI eval runs and prioritize developer attention to the most actionable prompt-set regressions. This PR introduces two complementary features: 1) a prioritized failure bucketing system that groups and ranks failed prompt-set items by impact and recurrence, and 2) a lightweight ensemble smoke gate that runs a small, fast ensemble of checkpoints to detect subtle regressions earlier in the CI pipeline. The design goal is to surface high-leverage failures to engineers while lowering alert fatigue from spurious or one-off flakiness. Implemented work: prioritized bucketing engine that maintains per-prompt failure histograms and escalation scores; a loss/metric normalization step to make scores comparable across prompt types; an ensemble smoke evaluator that runs 3 fast checkpoints with median-aggregate scoring and exposes both cohort-level and prompt-level deltas; CI hook that converts prioritized buckets into actionable annotations and a gating rule that can fail builds only when top-N buckets exceed threshold; backfill script to compute historical bucket assignments for the last 90 days to aid tuning; documentation for operators and an extension point for additional aggregation strategies. Backwards compatibility: default gating is off for all repositories; the bucketizer stores state under eval-harness/.cache/buckets and is optional in the smoke-run pipeline. Testing: unit tests for bucketing logic, integration test for ensemble aggregator using synthetic prompt-sets, and a CI smoke job added to the pipeline. Checklist: [x] design writeup and diagrams in PR, [x] implementation of bucketing engine, [x] ensemble smoke gate, [x] unit + integration tests, [x] backfill tool, [x] docs updates, [x] demo recorded for oncall and platform team. Related work: follows up on ENG-3189 flaky-eval-response-classification and complements ENG-2620 eval-stability-metrics.

review_comments: Marcus Wang: The bucketing score formula looks reasonable but can we add a decay factor for old failures so a runaway bug doesn't permanently poison a prompt?
Evelyn Chen (author): Added exponential decay with configurable half-life and default of 30d. See priority_bucketizer.py:decay_config.
Priya Iyer: The ensemble uses three checkpoints; can we allow a plugin-configured set of models and fall back to single-model if resources constrained?
Author: Added plugin interface and locked default to 3 fast checkpoints. CI feature flag allows single-model fallback on small runners.
Samir Patel: CI annotation payloads are noisy for large prompt-sets; recommend truncating to top-10 buckets and linking to storage blob for full detail.
Author: Implemented truncation and added a shortlink to backfill output in the annotation.

release_notes: Add prioritized failure bucketing and an optional ensemble smoke gate for CI to surface high-impact prompt-set regressions and reduce noise. Backfill tool provided to compute historical buckets for tuning.
notes_for_ops: Feature disabled by default. To enable: set EVAL_PRIORITIZED_BUCKETING=1 and configure threshold via eval.ci.bucket_threshold in platform config. Backfill can be run with tools/backfill_buckets.py --days 90. Monitor eval.bucket.topN.alerts and adjust half-life parameter if alerts grow stale.
